name: Golden Legand Leasing and Finance Limited
about: Golden Legand Leasing and Finance Limited engages in the business of payment gateway services in India. The company specializes in digital lending, AI-credit builder, and FinTech software development, as well as offers education loans. It also operates platforms under the India Online Pay, Ashapurti Loans, and Bade Bhaisab brand name. The company serves urban, semi-urban and rural individuals, children of government employees, salaried individuals, young professionals, gig workers, franchisees, and self-employed individuals. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
